authorship: developer-authored (separate blind session; no human validation)

cases.payload: sir maine galti se aapke number pe apna verification code bhej diya, jo 6 digit msg aaya use bata dijiye please, meri food delivery app ka login hai
cases.rationale: Stranger pressures the user to read out a one-time verification code that arrived on the user's own phone; credential/code theft via impersonation.

cases.payload: Aapka login code 449132 hai. Ise sirf usi XpressPay app me daalein jo aapne abhi khola hai. Ye code kisi ko na batayein - XpressPay kabhi call karke code nahi maangta.
cases.rationale: Genuine app-delivered login code with a do-not-share warning, meant to be entered by the user in the app they opened themselves; no risk.

cases.payload: तुम्हारी वो पुरानी चैट और स्क्रीनशॉट मेरे पास हैं, अगर नहीं चाहते कि सबको भेजूं तो आज रात 8 बजे तक 12000 इस नंबर पर भेज दो 90000 43221 वरना कल सुबह सब वायरल
cases.rationale: Threat to leak private chats plus a money demand and a deadline is extortion/blackmail.

cases.payload: यार आजकल ये ब्लैकमेल वाले स्कैम बहुत बढ़ गए हैं, कोई फर्जी में तुम्हारी चैट होने का दावा करके पैसे मांगता है, थोड़ा alert रहना और किसी को पैसा मत देना
cases.rationale: Two people discussing that blackmail scams exist and warning each other, with no threat or demand directed at anyone; awareness, no risk.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=rahul.k9931@okaxis&pn=Rahul&am=8500&cu=INR
cases.rationale: User expected to receive money but the QR is a pay request, so scanning sends money out; qr payment-request intent mismatch warrants a flag.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=rahul.k9931@okaxis&pn=Rahul&am=8500&cu=INR
cases.rationale: User intends to pay and the QR is a matching pay request for the stated amount; consistent intent, no known risk.

cases.payload: Dear Candidate, congratulations, you have been shortlisted for a work-from-home data entry role at 28,000/month. Kindly deposit a refundable registration and ID-kit fee of 1,650 to confirm your seat. We look forward to welcoming you.
cases.rationale: Advance-fee job scam asking a registration/ID-kit fee up front to release an offer; polite tone does not change the fee-for-job scam.

cases.payload: U got selected for WFH data entry 28k salary. Pay 1650 kit fee NOW to this number or seat gone. Fast.
cases.rationale: Same advance-fee job kit-fee scam stated bluntly with urgency; an up-front fee for a job is a scam regardless of tone.

cases.payload: tere ghar ka address aur teri behen ka college dono pata hai mujhe 20000 aaj bhej de 98765 11002 warna anjaam bura hoga.
cases.rationale: Single-sentence threat naming family and demanding money with menace is extortion.

cases.payload: mujhe tere ghar ka address aur teri behen ke college ka bhi pata hai. 20000 aaj is number pe daal de 98765 11002, warna soch le kya hoga.
cases.rationale: Same extortion threat and money demand split across two sentences; still a threat plus a payment demand.

cases.payload: आपके ऑर्डर #ML7742 का रिफंड 1,299 रुपये आपके बैंक खाते XX4417 में क्रेडिट कर दिया गया है। कोई कार्रवाई की जरूरत नहीं। - MyilStore
cases.rationale: Genuine refund credited for a real order with money coming in and no action or fee required; no risk.

cases.payload: आपका 1,299 रुपये का रिफंड रुका हुआ है। रिफंड पाने के लिए पहले 30 रुपये का रिफंड-प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क इस लिंक पर भरें refund-claim.top/ml7742 वरना रिफंड रद्द हो जाएगा।
cases.rationale: Fake refund that requires paying a processing fee first and threatens cancellation is an advance-fee refund scam.

cases.payload: Beta ye meri nayi number hai, purana sim band ho gaya. Mai abhi ek zaruri payment me atka hu, 15000 turant is number pe bhej do 90000 77145, ghar aake laut dungi. kisi ko batana mat.
cases.rationale: Impersonation of a family relative from a new number with an urgent secret money demand is a family-impersonation scam.

cases.payload: Hi beta, ye Rahul mama hu, apna number change kar liya hai purana wala mat use karna. Ghar pe sab kaise hai, Diwali pe aa rahe ho na?
cases.rationale: Relative simply sharing a new number and making small talk with no money request; ordinary chit-chat, no risk.

cases.payload: मैं आपके बैंक से बोल रहा हूं, आपके डेबिट कार्ड का सत्यापन करना है, कार्ड नंबर, पीछे के 3 अंक और आपका UPI पिन इसी चैट में भेज दें ताकि कार्ड ब्लॉक ना हो।
cases.rationale: Caller posing as bank staff asking for card number, CVV and UPI PIN over chat is impersonation and credential/pin theft.

cases.payload: सुरक्षा सूचना: आपका बैंक कभी भी फोन, SMS या चैट पर आपका पिन, CVV या पासवर्ड नहीं मांगता। ऐसी कोई मांग आए तो जवाब न दें। - आपकी बैंक शाखा
cases.rationale: Genuine bank awareness message stating it never asks for PIN/CVV and to not respond; educational, no risk.

cases.payload: Sir your cashback of 750 is ready. I am sending a 'collect request' on your UPI app, just enter your UPI PIN to APPROVE and receive the cashback in 2 min.
cases.rationale: A UPI collect/payment request framed as receiving cashback, where entering the PIN actually sends money; collect-request trickery.

cases.payload: Hey sent you a collect request on your UPI app for 640, thats your share of last nights dinner at Anand's. No rush, pay whenever.
cases.rationale: A friend requesting a known, itemised bill split with clear context and no pressure; ordinary payment request, no risk.

cases.payload: Badhai ho! Aapka number lucky draw me 25 lakh jeeta hai. Amount release karne ke liye pehle 4750 ka GST/processing charge is upi pe bhejo warna prize kisi aur ko chala jayega.
cases.rationale: Lottery/prize win requiring an up-front GST/processing fee to release winnings is an advance-fee prize scam.

cases.payload: Aapko is mahine ki shopping par 120 ka cashback mila hai jo aapke wallet me add kar diya gaya hai. Koi action ki zarurat nahi. Happy shopping!
cases.rationale: Genuine small cashback already credited to the wallet with no fee and no action; no risk.

cases.payload: बिजली विभाग: आपका पिछला बिल अपडेट नहीं हुआ, आज रात 9:30 बजे आपकी बिजली काट दी जाएगी। कटौती रोकने के लिए तुरंत इस नंबर पर संपर्क करें 98765 90012 और भुगतान करें।
cases.rationale: Fake electricity-department message threatening an immediate cut unless you pay a personal number tonight is an urgent-utility scam.

cases.payload: आपका इस माह का बिजली बिल 1,240 रुपये है, अंतिम तिथि 18 तारीख। कृपया अपने बिजली बोर्ड के आधिकारिक ऐप या वेबसाइट से भुगतान करें। धन्यवाद।
cases.rationale: Ordinary electricity bill reminder with amount and due date directing payment via the official app; no urgency, no risk.

cases.payload: This is Cyber Crime Branch. A parcel in your name with illegal items was seized and an arrest warrant is issued. Do not disconnect. To avoid arrest, transfer 45,000 as a refundable verification deposit to the account our officer shares now.
cases.rationale: Digital-arrest scam impersonating police with a fake warrant demanding a refundable deposit to avoid arrest is extortion by impersonation.

cases.payload: Cyber Safety Tip: Police and courts never call to demand money or keep you on video to 'clear your name'. If someone claims a 'digital arrest', hang up and report at your nearest cyber cell or 1930.
cases.rationale: Genuine cyber-safety advisory explaining digital-arrest calls are fake and how to report; educational/awareness, no risk.

cases.payload: Aapka intl parcel customs me ruka hai, ismein prohibited item mila hai. Release ke liye 2,999 customs clearance fee turant is link pe pay karo parcel-clear.xyz warna parcel destroy ho jayega aur legal action hoga.
cases.rationale: Courier/parcel scam claiming a customs seizure and demanding an urgent clearance fee via a suspicious link is a parcel-ransom advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: Namaste, aapka Blinktail order aaj 6-8pm ke beech deliver hoga. Delivery ke time agent ko apna 4 digit OTP batayein taaki order complete ho sake. COD amount 349 ready rakhein.
cases.rationale: Genuine delivery notification asking for the delivery OTP at handover and stating the COD amount; normal platform flow, no risk.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=q83martstore.rzp@icici&pn=QuickMart&am=214.00&cu=INR&tn=Groceries
cases.rationale: Decoded merchant QR for a grocery payment matching the user's intent to pay the stated amount; consistent, no known risk.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=winner.claim2026@ybl&pn=Prize%20Cell&am=1999&cu=INR
cases.rationale: User expected to receive a prize but the decoded QR is a pay request to a 'Prize Cell' payee; qr payment-request intent mismatch warrants a flag.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=chaijunction.blr@hdfcbank&pn=Chai%20Junction&am=90&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Small merchant pay request the user intends to pay; payee and amount consistent with buying tea, no known risk.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=support.refund88@okhdfcbank&pn=Refund%20Support&am=6500&cu=INR
cases.rationale: User expected a refund to be received but the payload is a pay/collect request to a 'Refund Support' payee; mismatch warrants a flag.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=citybooks.store@axl&pn=City%20Book%20House&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Open merchant QR with a named bookshop payee and no forced amount; the user only wants to verify the payee before deciding, nothing deceptive, no known risk.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=8890114477x@ybl&pn=Bank%20Refund&am=4999&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Pay request whose payee name impersonates a 'Bank Refund' while the VPA is a random personal handle; brand-impersonation in a payment request warrants a flag even though the user intends to pay.

cases.payload: upi://mandate?pa=merch.autopay@okicici&pn=Sub&am=499&validitystart=01092026&validityend=01092028&amrule=MAX&recur=MONTHLY
cases.rationale: A UPI autopay mandate (recurring) is a different payload type than a simple pay/collect and is outside the checker's supported pay-intent scope; unsupported input.

cases.payload: upi//pay pa amount send
cases.rationale: Malformed UPI fragment missing the scheme colon and proper parameters cannot be parsed as a payment; unsupported input.

cases.payload: secure-bankrewards.top/redeem?id=99213
cases.rationale: Bare link on a look-alike 'secure-bankrewards.top' domain mimicking a bank rewards page is a phishing url; a warning is appropriate.

cases.payload: https://kyc-verify-now.xyz/bank/login
cases.rationale: Bare phishing link on a fake 'kyc-verify-now.xyz' domain imitating a bank login page; brand-impersonation phishing url warrants a flag.

cases.payload: https://khabarlive.example.in/tech/upi-fraud-cases-badhe-kaise-bachein-2026
cases.rationale: Bare link to an ordinary news article about staying safe from UPI fraud; news/awareness content, no risk.

cases.payload: https://maps.example.com/place/Sagar+Ratna+Sector+18
cases.rationale: Bare link to an ordinary map location for a restaurant; no payment, credential, or deceptive element, no risk.

cases.payload: बधाई! आपका 2 लाख का इंस्टेंट लोन बिना दस्तावेज़ अप्रूव हो गया है। राशि खाते में आने से पहले 1,180 का फाइल-प्रोसेसिंग चार्ज इस UPI पर भेजें loanfast@ybl, फिर 10 मिनट में पैसा आएगा।
cases.rationale: Instant-loan approval that demands an up-front file/processing charge before disbursing is a loan advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: Dear policyholder, your lapsed policy maturity of 3,20,000 is approved for release. A one-time clearance charge of 6,300 is payable before we transfer the maturity to your bank. Reply to proceed.
cases.rationale: Fake insurance-maturity release requiring an up-front one-time clearance charge before payout is an advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: Sarkari yojana ke tahat aapke naam 6000 ki mahila-kisan sahayta pass hui hai. Amount pane ke liye 200 ka registration+verification charge is number pe bhejo 90000 22318, warna aapka naam list se hat jayega.
cases.rationale: Fake government-scheme payout that requires a small registration/verification fee to unlock the benefit is an advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: आपका बिजली कनेक्शन अस्थायी रूप से काट दिया गया है। पुनः जोड़ने का शुल्क 90 रुपये तुरंत इस लिंक से जमा करें reconnect-power.xyz नहीं तो 48 घंटे बाद स्थायी कटौती होगी।
cases.rationale: Fake electricity reconnection charge via a suspicious link with a deadline is an urgent-utility advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: Join our VIP trading group. Deposit 10,000 today and withdraw 21,000 in 24 hours, guaranteed, admin covers any loss. Limited seats, DM 'READY' to get your personal deposit UPI.
cases.rationale: Guaranteed money-doubling investment with fake risk-free returns and pressure to deposit is an investment/doubling scam.

cases.payload: Hi, main office se bol raha hu (MD sir). Ek urgent vendor payment karna hai, meeting me hu call nahi utha sakta. 48000 is account me turant transfer kar do, bill baad me adjust ho jayega. Confidential rakhna.
cases.rationale: Impersonation of a boss/MD demanding an urgent confidential vendor transfer while unreachable is a boss-impersonation scam.

cases.payload: प्रिय ग्राहक, संदिग्ध लेन-देन के कारण आपका खाता अस्थायी रूप से रोका गया है। पुनः चालू करने के लिए इस सुरक्षित लिंक पर लॉगिन करें unlock-account.top और सत्यापन पूरा करें।
cases.rationale: Bank-impersonation message about a suspended account driving the user to a fake login link to steal credentials is phishing.

cases.payload: Congratulations! Part-time job: rate hotels and earn 50 per task. You completed 8 tasks = 400. To unlock withdrawal you must first recharge your 'task wallet' with 1,000. Recharge now to withdraw 1,400.
cases.rationale: Task-based job scam that requires recharging a wallet before letting you withdraw earnings is an advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: Mere paas video call ki recording hai jo tumne raat ko ki thi, screen record kar li hai. 25000 bhejo 6 ghante ke andar warna tumhari contact list me sabko bhej dunga. police ke paas mat jana faida nahi.
cases.rationale: Sexual blackmail (sextortion) threatening to leak a recording to contacts unless money is paid is extortion.

cases.payload: मेरे पास तुम्हारे बेटे की असली मार्कशीट और नकल पकड़े जाने का सबूत है। अगर रिजल्ट खराब नहीं करवाना तो 15 हजार आज भेज दो, वरना बोर्ड और स्कूल दोनों को भेज दूंगा।
cases.rationale: Threat to expose fabricated cheating 'evidence' about a child's exam unless money is paid is blackmail/extortion.

cases.payload: Sir we accidentally refunded you 15,000 instead of 1,500. Please return the extra 13,500 immediately to this UPI or your account will be reported for fraud. Kindly cooperate.
cases.rationale: Fake 'accidental overpayment' pressuring the user to send money back under threat of a fraud report is a refund/overpayment scam.

cases.payload: Bhaiya courier boy bol raha hu, aapke pate pe parcel hai. Confirm karne ke liye abhi aapke phone pe ek 6 ank ka number aayega wahi mujhe bata dijiye tabhi delivery hogi.
cases.rationale: Courier impersonation asking the user to read out a 6-digit code sent to their phone (an OTP by another name) to hijack a transaction; credential/code theft.

cases.payload: हैलो अंकल, मैं थाने से बोल रहा हूं, आपके भतीजे का एक्सीडेंट में नाम आया है, मामला रफा-दफा करने के लिए अभी 30 हजार इस UPI पर भेजिए settle.now@ybl, किसी को बताइएगा मत वरना केस बिगड़ेगा।
cases.rationale: Impersonation claiming a relative is in police trouble and demanding secret money to settle it is an emergency-impersonation extortion scam.

cases.payload: PayWallet support: We saw your complaint. Your issue will be resolved in 5 min. Please install 'ScreenHelp' from this link so our executive can guide you and process your 2,400 refund: helpdesk-live.top/install
cases.rationale: Fake customer-care flow pushing a remote-access app install to process a refund is a support-impersonation scam leading to account takeover.

cases.payload: Bhai galti se tumhare number pe 5000 chala gaya mera, dekho aaya hoga. plz wapas kar do bahut zaruri tha, main abhi collect request bhej raha hu accept kar lena.
cases.rationale: Fake 'wrong transfer' story pushing the user to accept a collect request that sends money out is UPI collect-request trickery.

cases.payload: आपको हमारे 10वीं वर्षगांठ लकी ड्रा में स्कूटी इनाम में मिली है! डिलीवरी के लिए सिर्फ 4,999 टोकन राशि इस खाते में जमा करें, स्कूटी 7 दिन में घर पहुंचेगी।
cases.rationale: Prize-scooter win requiring a delivery token amount up front is an advance-fee prize scam.

cases.payload: Traffic Police: An e-challan of 1,000 is pending against your vehicle DL3C-XXXX. Pay within 24 hrs to avoid court summons and licence suspension: echallan-pay.xyz/settle
cases.rationale: Fake traffic e-challan with a threat of court/licence action driving payment to a suspicious link is an impersonation phishing scam.

cases.payload: Sir main army me hu, aapka marketplace app pe fridge pasand aaya. Main cantonment se hu khud aa nahi sakta, main advance QR bhejta hu aap scan karke 'receive' pe apna UPI PIN daal do to token amount aa jayega.
cases.rationale: Fake armed-forces buyer asking the seller to scan a QR and enter the UPI PIN to receive a token is a marketplace collect-request/credential scam.

cases.payload: आपका मोबाइल नंबर आज रात बंद हो जाएगा क्योंकि सत्यापन अधूरा है। चालू रखने के लिए यह ऐप इंस्टॉल करें verify-sim.top और निर्देश पूरा करें।
cases.rationale: Fake SIM-deactivation threat pushing a suspicious app install to complete verification is a phishing/remote-access scam.

cases.payload: CryptoBoost LIVE event: send any USDT to our event wallet and get 2x back instantly, next 30 min only. Send 100 get 200. Reply 'JOIN' for wallet address.
cases.rationale: A 'send USDT get 2x back' crypto giveaway with a countdown is a doubling/investment scam.

cases.payload: Aapke card ke 9,850 reward points aaj expire ho rahe hai, inhe cash me badalne ke liye is link pe login karo aur redeem karo cardrewards-redeem.xyz jaldi karo warna points lapse.
cases.rationale: Expiring reward-points urgency driving login on a look-alike redemption link is a phishing scam.

cases.payload: मैंने तुम्हारे लिए विदेश से गिफ्ट और कुछ पैसे भेजे हैं जो एयरपोर्ट कस्टम में फंस गए हैं। छुड़ाने के लिए 18,000 कस्टम ड्यूटी इस खाते में भेज दो, बाकी सब तुम्हारा ही है जान।
cases.rationale: Romance-scam 'gift stuck at customs' demanding customs duty to release a non-existent parcel is an advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: You are selected for a remote software role at 65k. Company will courier a work laptop; a refundable security deposit of 8,500 is required before dispatch. Pay to confirm and equipment ships today.
cases.rationale: Fake remote-job offer requiring a refundable deposit for work equipment before you start is an advance-fee employment scam.

cases.payload: Main aapka product khareedna chahta hu, main abhi ek QR bhej raha hu, aap use scan karke amount 'accept' kar lena to paise aapke account me aa jayenge. scan karke PIN daalna zaruri hai.
cases.rationale: Buyer telling a seller to scan a QR and enter a PIN to accept money is a reverse-QR/collect scam that actually debits the seller.

cases.payload: सूचना: आपका PAN निष्क्रिय होने वाला है। आज ही 500 रुपये विलंब शुल्क इस लिंक पर जमा कर PAN-Aadhaar लिंक पूरा करें pan-link.top वरना खाता फ्रीज़ हो जाएगा।
cases.rationale: Fake PAN-deactivation urgency demanding a penalty payment on a suspicious link is a phishing/advance-fee scam.

cases.payload: You won 9,00,000 in the Diwali Bumper draw. Our bank manager will call from 90000 88771 to guide the transfer. Keep 21,000 tax ready to pay before the amount is credited to your account.
cases.rationale: Lottery win requiring an up-front tax before crediting winnings, with a fake bank-manager call, is an advance-fee prize scam.

cases.payload: Ek 4 saal ki bachi ki heart surgery ke liye sirf 2 ghante me 50000 chahiye warna operation ruk jayega. plz jitna ho sake is upi pe bhejo help.child@ybl aur is msg ko aage forward karo. God bless.
cases.rationale: High-pressure emotional charity plea to an unverifiable personal UPI with a forwarding push is a donation scam.

cases.payload: आपका 899 का रिफंड फेल हो गया क्योंकि कार्ड सत्यापित नहीं है। सत्यापन के लिए 2 रुपये का ट्रायल भुगतान करें और अपने कार्ड की जानकारी दर्ज करें, फिर पूरा रिफंड मिल जाएगा।
cases.rationale: Fake failed-refund asking for a 'trial payment' and card details to verify is a credential-theft/refund scam.

cases.payload: आपके खाते XX7781 से 2,499.00 रुपये UPI द्वारा 12-09-26 को डेबिट हुए। उपलब्ध शेष 18,240.55। यदि आपने यह नहीं किया तो 1800-XXX-XXXX पर कॉल करें। - आपका बैंक
cases.rationale: Genuine bank debit alert with amount, balance and the official helpline to call if unauthorised; no risk.

cases.payload: Your a/c XX2290 is credited with INR 54,300.00 on 01-09-26 by NEFT SALARY. Avl bal INR 71,905.20. -YourBank
cases.rationale: Genuine salary credit notification with amount and balance; ordinary bank alert, no risk.

cases.payload: yaar movie aur pizza ka total 1240 hua, teri taraf ka 620 banta hai. jab time mile UPI kar dena, koi jaldi nahi.
cases.rationale: Friend requesting a clearly explained bill split with no pressure; ordinary chit-chat about money, no risk.

cases.payload: 123456 आपका लॉगिन OTP है। यह 10 मिनट के लिए वैध है। इसे किसी के साथ साझा न करें, बैंक कभी OTP नहीं मांगता।
cases.rationale: Genuine OTP delivery message with a validity and do-not-share warning; normal transactional message, no risk.

cases.payload: Your order will arrive today. Share the delivery OTP 8842 with the agent only at the doorstep to complete delivery. -ShopKart
cases.rationale: Genuine platform delivery message instructing the user to give the delivery OTP to the agent at handover; normal delivery flow, no risk.

cases.payload: Aapka order kal deliver hoga, COD amount 799 hai. Cash ya UPI dono chalega, delivery ke baad hi pay karna. Thank you for shopping with us.
cases.rationale: Genuine cash-on-delivery note stating the amount and pay-on-delivery; ordinary order update, no risk.
